create_mongo_resource: create a MongoResource dataclass to connect to a MongoDB database with a mongoengine alias
check_mongo_availability: check if a MongoResource database connection is available using the is_available method
enable_change_stream_images: enable pre and post images on a MongoDB collection using enable_pre_and_post_images
create_cache_mongo_resource: create a CacheMongoResource dataclass to connect to the cache MongoDB database
create_queue_mongo_resource: create a QueueMongoResource dataclass to connect to the queue MongoDB database
